children: Oil falls in early Asian trade, after settling higher overnight. Vice President JD Vance is engaging one of Iran's most powerful hard-liners to revive peace negotiations even as President Trump threatens to restart the war after next week's midterm elections, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing U.S. officials and people familiar with the matter. Risks remain elevated for oil prices with Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure coming under repeated attacks from the Yemen-based Houthis, ANZ Research analysts say in a note. Front-month WTI crude-oil futures are down 0.7% at $102.10 a barrel, while front-month Brent is 0.6% lower at $114.60 a barrel, ICE data show.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
